packageRules.description: Chainguard image digests are updated by digestabot
Chainguard Libraries for Go withholds releases for 1 day (go-1d-cooldown policy on max.bern); wait until they can be pulled
Chainguard hardened actions: follow full vX.Y.Z tags only (vX.Y.Z-rN are revision tags). Chainguard moves a tag when it re-hardens a version, which arrives as a digest update
